Richard Hammond stands beside him in a beige shirt and bright orange wristwatch, burying his face completely inside his hands as he struggles for air. Clarkson lets out high-pitched, wheezing gasps of pure hilarity, slapping his own knee and staggering backward in sheer amusement. Hammond shakes his head in absolute disbelief, his shoulders trembling with silent, convulsive giggles. The bright green background is completely uniform, making it ready for instant composite over any user interface, code diff, or competitor comparison. Clarkson recovers just enough to point forward again, only to buckle over in another fit of wheezing laughter. The clip ends on both hosts physically incapacitated by the sheer absurdity of the joke.
